verdict.rationale: Casium publishes attorney-reviewed visa guides for O-1A, H-1B, TN, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW and International Entrepreneur Parole. It also offers some selection guidance: it positions O-1 as an option for people not selected in the H-1B lottery, and its individual service 'lays out the pathway ahead.' Missing for 10: any E-2 guide, explicit coverage of cap-exempt H-1B routes (only cap-subject filing is mentioned), a structured founder-focused decision guide across the visa menu, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation
